en-US.name: Remove Ads
en-US.description: Permanently remove all ads, including interstitial and app-open ads, for a faster and uninterrupted experience.
en-US.promoText: Enjoy Püper ad-free forever with a one-time purchase.

review.notes: This non-consumable purchase permanently removes interstitial and app-open ads throughout the app. A Restore Purchases button is available in Settings for re-installs and new devices.
